# DSH Studio v0.9.13

## Fixes and polish

- Replace native dropdown popups with the shared menu-backed selector, including checked radio-menu semantics, active keyboard navigation, restored trigger focus, and consistent disabled states.
- Match the measured desktop controls with 8×5 px chevrons, 12 px dropdown corners, 6 px menu gutters, 8×12 px item padding, 14 px item text, 18 px indicators, and 590 selected-item weight.
- Keep outline inputs transparent with a neutral 50% inset focus edge, while selectors use the distinct inward 2 px blue focus ring. Command rows now use the reference 75% resting opacity and quieter translucent highlight.
- Remove owned, content-hashed web assets before Windows NSIS upgrades so old bundles cannot survive an in-place install or block complete uninstall. Full installers refresh their owned offline payload; Lite updates preserve it.
- Supersede the incomplete `v0.9.12` release run, whose Windows Full upgrade check caught the stale package resources.

## Installation and limitations

- Upgrade in place or use the in-app updater. Full includes offline dependencies; Lite downloads them when needed.
- The interface keeps the OpenAI Sans-first font stack but does not bundle OpenAI font files; systems without that font use the native UI fallback.

## Verification

- Local frontend build, lint, 275 frontend tests at 95.1% statement coverage, 59 packaging script tests, Rust workspace tests, accessibility checks, and public-contract checks passed.
- Lite and Full Windows NSIS installers compiled locally with their separate upgrade hooks. Browser checks verified input and dropdown selection states in dark and light themes.
- The release pipeline validates Lite and Full packages on Linux, Windows, and macOS, including an in-place Windows upgrade and clean uninstall, before publishing checksums and the signed updater manifest.
